accepted.finding: The mark is wholly detached below the short yod shaft. It retains two rounded upper lobes with a middle notch and a short broad lower central node of comparable width. That complete three-node triangle repeats the literal detached same-font lamed segol and gimel segol contours. The exact yod qamats counter has a longer thin lower stem/button, and the exact yod tsere counter a horizontal pair without the third lower node. The surviving complete geometry certifies segol independently of expected wording; no dagesh or other omitted mark is supplied.
